blocks.text: Proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates aur lipids mukhtalif qisam ke monomers se jorhe jate hain. Yeh tamam biomolecules apne monomers ko condensation ya dehydration ke amal se jorte hain. Condensation ke dauran ek monomer se -OH group hataya jata hai aur doosre monomer se -H atom. Ise dehydration synthesis bhi kehte hain, kyunke OH aur H groups hatane ka matlab pani ka ek molecule hatana hai. Do glucose monomers se maltose ka banna condensation reaction ki misal hai.

blocks.title: Tawanai (energy) chahiye
blocks.text: Jab monomers se pani nikala jata hai to kemiyai bonds torne ke liye tawanai darkar hoti hai, is liye macromolecules banane ke liye cells ko tawanai mohayya karni parti hai.

Monomers jor kar polymers banane ke saath-saath cells polymers torte bhi rehte hain. Hydrolysis woh kemiyai amal hai jis mein macromolecule (polymer) pani ke molecules shamil kar ke chhote tukron mein tora jata hai. Yeh dehydration synthesis ka ulta hai: cells monomers ke darmiyan bonds mein pani shamil kar ke unhen torte hain. Is amal mein pani ke molecule ka OH group ek monomer se jurta hai aur hydrogen doosre monomer se. Pani ka ek molecule shamil kar ke maltose ka do glucose monomers mein tootna hydrolysis ki misal hai.

blocks.alt: Upar: do glucose rings jin ke OH aur HO groups aamne-samne hain oxygen bridge se jur kar maltose banate hain, aur pani ka ek molecule nikalta hai. Neeche: maltose mein pani ka molecule shamil hota hai, bridge toot-ta hai, aur do alag glucose molecules apne OH groups ke saath wapas aate hain.
blocks.caption: Dehydration synthesis aur hydrolysis, maltose aur glucose ke saath (Figures 4.4 aur 4.5 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Condensation (dehydration synthesis) mein ek monomer se OH aur doosre se H hataya jata hai; monomers glycosidic bond se jurte hain aur pani ka ek molecule nikalta hai, jis par tawanai kharch hoti hai. Hydrolysis mein pani shamil kiya jata hai: us ka OH ek monomer se aur H doosre se jurta hai, to bond toot-ta hai aur monomers alag ho jate hain, jaise hazma (digestion) aur tanaffus (respiration) mein.

blocks.title: Hydrolysis kyun aham hai
blocks.text: Macromolecules ka tootna hazma aur cellular respiration jaise hayatiyati (biological) amal mein zaroori hai, jahan tawanai banane ke liye chhote molecules chahiye hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Likhen ke jab disaccharide banta hai aur jab toot-ta hai to pani ke molecule ke atoms ka kya hota hai.
blocks.explanation: Banna: ek glucose ka OH aur doosre ka H mil kar pani ka ek molecule ban kar nikalte hain, aur do sugars oxygen bridge se jurte hain. Tootna: pani ka molecule toot-ta hai; us ka OH ek glucose se aur H doosre se jurta hai, aur do azaad monosaccharides wapas milte hain.

items: Condensation (dehydration synthesis) ek monomer se OH aur doosre se H pani ki soorat mein nikal kar monomers jorta hai; ise tawanai chahiye. Misal: glucose + glucose se maltose.
Hydrolysis is ka ulta hai: pani shamil hota hai, us ke OH aur H dono monomers ko jate hain, aur bond toot-ta hai. Misal: maltose se do glucose. Hazma aur tanaffus is par munhasir hain.
